newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares end up, correct part of Monday's loss.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares end up, correct part of Monday's loss.

text.p: Greek equities reversed course and gained 0.71 percent in moderate turnover recovering part of their losses in the last two trading days and analysts said the market would be channeled bound awaiting economic policy signals.

"We witnessed a correction today after two consecutive drops," said Vassilis Kletsas of Telesis Securities. "We expect the bourse to consolidate above 930 points till the government gives clear, solid signals of its future economic policy ."
No uptrend can be sustained without cash injections, added Kletsas.
Many analysts and brokers have attributed the recent retreat of the benchmark index to lack of fresh cash inflows.

Greece's new socialist cabinet was sworn in last week with Yannos Papandoniou elevated to economic "czar", heading both the national economy and finance ministries. The socialists have a comfortable 162-seat majority in the 300-seat parliament.
The Athens general share index closed 0.71 percent, or 6.78 points higher at 960.39 from Monday's 953.61 close after opening at 953.60 points.
Turnover slipped to 7.12 billion drachmas on volume of 3.50 million shares.

Gainers led decliners 105 to 104 with 32 issues unchanged on 241 traded. Banks gained 0.49 percent, industrials rose 1.01 percent and construction firmed 0.23 percent. Small-caps settled with gains of 0.86 percent.

The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 560-578 at the close. Shares of OTE telecom, the underlying, ended up 40 drachmas at 4,095 after heavy trade.

The recently launched Merrill Lynch stock index call warrant based on a basket of 23 shares was higher at 203.10-213.80 drachmas. It expires on January 9 1998 with a strike price of 1000. It was in the money at 1051.2.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted higher at 4,467-4,748 drachmas at the close.
